task.title: Page finite recurrence inventory through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/985 to expose bounded recurrence inventory pages as deterministic read-only JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Validate page size and optional exact recurrence-ID cursor before storage access.
Emit complete recurrences and nullable next_after in deterministic exact-ID order.
Delegate bounded selection to the kernel through existing read-only storage and emit no partial stdout on failure.

attempts.diagnostic: The CLI rejected recurrence page because the paging subcommand did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added focused CLI tests for ordering, continuation, terminal pages, escaping, validation, storage absence, and corruption isolation.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded adapter.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented pre-storage input validation, read-only list_page delegation, and compact continuation JSON using the canonical recurrence serializer.
attempts.patch: Implemented issue 985 in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with focused tests, ADR-0092, and scheduler documentation.

attempts.summary: Recorded independent and substantive review disposition.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found no blocking issue. Genuine CodeRabbit run 48dac4bf raised one selected-lookahead test comment; the contract-based rebuttal was posted before merge, but the unresolved thread raced the merge and CodeRabbit withdrew the finding afterward.
attempts.patch: No code change was warranted because ADR-0091 requires validation of the page-size-plus-one lookahead; the post-merge withdrawal confirmed that interpretation and resolved the thread.

outcome.summary: Issue 985 delivered bounded recurrence inventory JSON while preserving kernel cursor and validation authority.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 986 exact head fd51a681b874886ba62da87caa3a932aff4dc90b

lessons: The adapter should validate caller-owned bounds and identity before opening storage.
Kernel continuation evidence should be serialized directly rather than reconstructed in the CLI.
The command adds no persisted cursor, status filtering, lifecycle, clock, dispatch, permission, or execution authority.
